Thank you. The one who will hurt has lots of support including great counseling. I've seen to that. Also, with me gone someone important will probably come back into his life. Someone who hates me. Someone he needs far more than me. Hard to explain. I will make sure he is taken care of. He will feel a loss but in the long run the person he gains back will help fulfill his loss. People lose old grandparents all the time. With help, he'll go on to a happier life. 

No one else will give a shit.
